name: 25 circles in a square
description: The reference instance: 25 identical circles, as large as possible, in a 10 x 10 square. The 5 x 5 grid is optimal here, so any search that beats scale 2.0 is wrong. The solution loaded by default is the 5 x 5 grid at scale 2, which is optimal for this instance: any score above it would be an engine bug.
